subject: Exhibit roles and redline sprint plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Martha Li <martha@apertureai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exhibit roles and redline sprint plan

Hi Martha —

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Attaching our initial MSA and a draft Exhibit A so we can get the first pass out of the way. High level asks to keep this tight so we can scope procurement and billing properly: 

- Can you confirm the exact legal entity name for billing and where PO/Invoices should be sent? (we typically capture both a corporate legal name and the billing entity if different)
- Primary contract signatory (name + title + email) and backup signer if the primary is out
- Any mandatory data residency or export controls we need to flag in the MSA (EU-only, restricted dataset, etc.)
- Any procurement timelines or internal review windows (legal/finance) that would affect a 2-week redline sprint

Proposed timeline: we’ll take 48 hours to produce an initial redline from our side focused on priority commercial and SLAs, then schedule a 30–45 minute sync to walk through contested items. If that works, Kimberly will lead the redline log and Jordan will handle billing/PO questions.

Attachments: [Redlined_MSA_Aperture_20260713.docx (docx)], [ExhibitA_PartySheet.xlsx (xlsx)]

If you prefer, we can kick off a short call Thursday morning — propose 9:30am PT.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers inline.

> - Can you confirm the exact legal entity name for billing and where PO/Invoices should be sent?
We are "Aperture AI, Inc.", EIN 12-3456789. Invoices go to procurement@apertureai.com with a copy to finance-ops@apertureai.com.

> - Primary contract signatory (name + title + email)
Primary is Tom Reeves (Head of Procurement) — tom.reeves@apertureai.com. He is copied. Backup is Sarah Gomez (Finance Dir) sarah.gomez@apertureai.com.

> - Any mandatory data residency or export controls
We need to ensure no PHI leaves the EU region for any workload classified as "regulated"; otherwise US/EU standard hosting OK.

> > Proposed timeline: we’ll take 48 hours to produce an initial redline
Sounds reasonable. Procurement expects an internal review window of 3 business days after your redline. If you can get initial redlines by Thu EOD PT we should be able to respond before the following Tuesday.

We also have an indemnity carve-out request from our counsel around third-party model outputs — I'll attach a short note from our legal team in the next thread.

Thanks —
Martha

Hi Martha / Hannah —

Looping in the contracts intake items and priority list so everyone is aligned before we start redlines. Short version: focus our 48-hour pass on (1) indemnity/liability caps (2) data residency & security exhibit language (3) termination / transition assistance / IP carve-outs. Secondary items (billing cycles, SOW references) can be handled in the follow-up pass.

Action items from Redwood (assigned):
- Kimberly: prepare redline log + proposed negotiation positions for indemnity and cap (attach: Party_Details_Template.xlsx)
- Jordan: confirm billing entity and point of contact for PO processing and invoice terms
- Hannah: schedule kickoff call and owner the stakeholder timeline

Martha — a couple of quick asks for the intake sheet to keep our redline clean:
- Confirm whether the billing entity is strictly "Aperture AI, Inc." or if invoices need to go to a parent/legal affiliate — give us the corporate address used for W9s
- Can you share the counsel note on indemnity carve-outs you referenced? if it’s a short paragraph, we can slot counter language into the redline.
- If you have SOC2 or equivalent security evidence (SOC2 Type II report or an external security questionnaire) please share a link — we typically include a copy or reference in Exhibit B.

Attachments: [Party_Details_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

I’ll produce the initial Sierra-format redline and upload to the Drive link below so we can track edits. If legal wants to mark up a PDF we can accept that, but DOCX with tracked changes will speed iteration.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
